title: Want to recover filtered Yelp reviews? Here's how... | DealerOn

facts.fact: DealerOn's 'Why We Are Different' page states that the DealerOn difference includes 99% customer satisfaction (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: Experience the DealerOn difference – increased car sales, exceptional service, and 99% customer satisfaction.

facts.fact: This DealerOn blog article about recovering filtered Yelp reviews was published on June 13, 2018.
DealerOn's blog says that when it contacts filtered Yelp reviewers, it typically sees about a 20% response rate (the vendor's own observation).
facts.quote: Typically, we see about a 20% response rate when we do this sort of Yelp reviewer outreach.

facts.fact: DealerOn states that it has documented an average increase of over 200% in website lead volume for its auto dealer clients since creating its lead process in 2009 (vendor's own claim).
facts.quote: Since creating this process in 2009, DealerOn has documented an average increase of over 200% in website lead volume for their auto dealer clients.
